prompt:
What would be the clinical guidance for someone who is Poor Metabolizer for CYP2C19 with regards to taking voriconazole?

Answer briefly (under 200 words) with:
1. The guideline recommendation for this specific phenotype (avoid the drug / use an alternative / adjust the dose / standard use / no recommendation).
2. The strength or level of the recommendation, if known.
3. The source (which guideline).

If you have tools available, use them to check before answering. If you cannot determine the answer, say so rather than guessing.

arguments.query: CPIC guideline voriconazole CYP2C19 poor metabolizer recommendation

final_answer:
**1. Recommendation:** Avoid voriconazole as first-line therapy if possible and use an agent not dependent on CYP2C19, such as isavuconazole, liposomal amphotericin B, or posaconazole. If voriconazole is still the best choice, use a lower-than-standard dose with careful therapeutic drug monitoring. Poor metabolizers have higher voriconazole trough levels and more adverse events.

**2. Strength:** Reported as "Moderate" in one summary of the CPIC table. I could not confirm this against the full guideline, so check the classification there.

**3. Source:** CPIC guideline for CYP2C19 and voriconazole therapy (Moriyama et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2017;102(1):45-51; PMID 27981572). The [CPIC voriconazole supplement](https://cpicpgx.org/content/guideline/publication/voriconazole/2016/Voriconazole_Supplement_2016.pdf) and the [NCBI Bookshelf summary](https://ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK552035) were also consulted.

Sources:
- [PMC5474211](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5474211)
- [PubMed 27981572](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27981572/)
- [CPIC Voriconazole Supplement 2016](https://cpicpgx.org/content/guideline/publication/voriconazole/2016/Voriconazole_Supplement_2016.pdf)
- [NCBI Bookshelf NBK552035](https://ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK552035)
- [UF Health CYP2C19 and Voriconazole](https://precisionmedicine.ufhealth.org/how-to-interpret-results/cyp2c19-and-voriconazole/)

judge.note_es: La respuesta recomienda evitar voriconazol y usar una alternativa (anfotericina B liposomal, posaconazol), con dosis menor y monitorización si se usa; cita correctamente la guía CPIC de Moriyama 2017 con PMID válido.
